استعدين (form X)
# اِسْتَعْدَيْنَ (istaʕdayna) /is.taʕ.daj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَعْدَى (istaʕdā)
# اُسْتُعْدِينَ (ustuʕdīna) /us.tuʕ.diː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَعْدَى (istaʕdā)
# اِسْتَعْدِينَ (istaʕdīna) /is.taʕ.diː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَعْدَى (istaʕdā)
